question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Below the belt**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "Unfair or unjust behavior". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Below the belt"** refers to an action or remark that is unfair, unjust, or unethical, often targeting someone in a way that is considered inappropriate or hurtful. (अनुचित या अन्यायपूर्ण व्यवहार) • **Example:** His comment about her family was definitely below the belt and completely uncalled for. • The idiom originates from the sport of boxing, where hitting below the waistline is against the rules and considered unfair. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Hitting someone lightly** (किसी को हल्के से मारना): This means to strike or touch someone gently. • **Example:** He hit the ball lightly to avoid it going out of bounds. • **Option 2: Doing something with great care** (किसी काम को बहुत सावधानीपूर्वक करना): This refers to performing an action with meticulous attention and precision. • **Example:** She painted the picture with great care to capture every detail. • **Option 3: A punch in boxing** (मुक्केबाजी में एक पंच): This refers to a physical blow delivered in the sport of boxing. • **Example:** His powerful punch in boxing earned him the winning title. 40:Tb9b, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Lovers whose relationship is doomed.
